{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Filter for completed orders and exclude QA orders
completed_clean_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (~qa_mask)]

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders, excluding QA orders
mean_revenue = completed_clean_df['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Verify that QA orders are excluded
qa_in_completed = qa_mask & (df['status'] == 'completed')
assert qa_in_completed.sum() == 0, "QA orders should not be in completed set"

# Print final result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue:.2f} USD")"}
